// diagnostic E0401

Jet.FallibleWhereValueExpected

Fallible value used where plain `T` expected

What

Fallible value used where plain `T` expected

Why

A fallible value may hold a failure, so it must be handled before it is used as a plain value

Fix

Handle the fallible result or use it in a fallible context.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.FallibleWhereValueExpected: Tests/UI/fallible_where_value_expected.stderr.

 13 | use_fallible: fn(r: Int Bad!) -> Int { take_int(r) }

 Why: A fallible result must be checked before its value is used
 Fix: Use `?`, `??`, or test with `== Ok(...)` / `== Err(...)`
